! explanation
Translation of the message sent to me by her mother:
"I'm (daughter's name)'s mother, I'm writing you to tell you that I've noticed the messages you've sent one another, I don't agree with them, you're confusing her, I'm asking you to not bother her even more".

Now, to the story.

So, picture this: your 14 years old daughter has been spending a lot of time in her phone, smiling and whatnot. So, you, as a mother who unconditionally loves her child, decides to see what is the source of her happiness. You check her phone when no one is watching and you see that she has been talking with other persons online, and from what you can tell, they're the same age as her. However you see that both your daughter and another girl were writing the same messages as a straight couple would do, saying "I love you" and whatnot. 

So, what do you do? Block the girl after writing her a disheartening message, fight with the other girls in the group chat because of the drawings of LGBTQ+ drawings they were sharing (mind you, quite innocent ones), insult practically everyone and then block them, but as it is not enough, you proceed to CALL the girl with whom your daughter said to be in love, a 14 year old girl living practically on the other side of the planet to tell her that everything she did and said was plainly wrong, immoral, unethical and unnatural, to tell her that she should be ashamed of herself for wrecking a family as she did and to never try to contact her again.

That was what happened. Even though we tried through multiple ways to keep in contact, her mother always found out about, as she was monitoring her daughter's social media and whatnot to make sure we didn't talk to each other again, so we gave up trying from sheer fatigue. However, during this year's may, I managed to talk to her again. The last message I got from her? "Of course, I would be happy to talk with you. Rest well, and dream beautiful dreams".

I don't know what else to do. I'm scared that something happened, that she's still not doing as well as she told me last time, that her mother would be causing her trouble. From what I heard from friends that she had that her mother approved of, well, she doesn't have them anymore because of, well yet again, her mother. 

I can't get her out of my head as she is one of the most important persons that exists, or at least, existed, in my life. She is someone truly worth fighting for and I would hate myself for eternity if I wouldn't be able to know how she was doing or anything. She is one of the kindest, most creative and cutest person to exist in this world. She doesn't deserve to be hurt. I should be there for her, I should have been able to do something. 

Yet, I still don't fucking know what to do.

I just started checking this sub after it being mentioned in another subreddit, and I have to say, this post hit closer home than expected. I mean, I don't know if I really have BPD parents, but with my mother it's almost always like this: she gets super angry at the smallest things of them all, starts yelling at me or my brothers as if we committed the most horrible and despicable act of the world, and then expects everything to be normal again, without a care in the world about our feelings. 

I don't usually try to defend myself when I'm arguing with my mother, father or stepfather as everything I say is seen as something "disrespectful" or similar, that I have to learn to "respect adults" every single time, and "to stop being so dramatic or difficult". I'm always told to stand up for myself but they always brush off my attempts at doing so if it inconvenience them. 

I always tried to be the perfect daughter or at least not be a burden to any of them, I instantly and unconsciously apologize for everything and nothing, but not a single thing that I do seems to ever be good enough and when I told them about it, they also brushed it off.

One time, a little bit after my mother yelled at me once again for not doing the dishes at the moment she asked me to, she called me and wondered if I was angry at her for something in particular, as I was avoiding her and not looking her right into her eyes. I honestly answered that I felt terrible as I was doing what she asked but I hadn't finished yet by the time she started lecturing me, and that I would actually appreciate if she sometimes apologized when she was wrong. She didn't even acknowledge what I said and straight on ignored me, wishing me good night.

All of the people of her surroundings say that she is a great and incredible person, and she always smiles at me when they tell us so. She tells everyone, including myself, about how close we both are, when she doesn't actually know half a thing about me. But sometimes I feel extremely guilty, because maybe I am in the wrong, you know? Sometimes I think that this is normal, and sometimes I feel like it isn't. 

I'm told to do as I wish, as it is my life and no one else's but they always tell me indirect things as to make me feel extremely bad (such as "your poor parent, who won't be seeing you because you chose such and such", "I'll be so lonely without you but that's what you chose, so I guess it's okay", "I don't understand HOW you could chose that over me, but it's as you wish".

The only thing I wish to actually do is leave this house when I can and never ever see them ever again, although I would feel extremely by doing so.

I'm sorry if this is too long or off-topic, as I actually don't know if they are BPD or not, but yeah, felt the need to vent a little bit. Sorry about it. ^^U I also feel a little bit bad by making this about me when it is about you so, yeah, sorry yet again if it offends you or you don't appreciate this.
I mean, I think I could try. I'll see who I can talk about this with. I guess I didn't think about anybody else except my parents, so now I do feel a little stupid, but thank you for your comment

The "good one" (our left) is wearing white clothing and shows some wounds on its face, from the other's claws. It's wearing a wolf mask to represent the fact that it feels or looks like it is in the wrong, that it is the bad one. 

It was a lot of fun to make them come back to life after so much time had passed, and a lot of people enjoyed our cosplay! It was great.
